calls.statement:
SELECT status, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)='2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_day,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)='2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) local_day
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2025-11-29' AND order_ts_utc < '2025-12-04'
GROUP BY status

WITH o AS (
 SELECT *, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS local_date
 FROM fact_web_order)
SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM o WHERE local_date='2025-12-01') AS local_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM o WHERE local_date='2025-12-01') AS local_ids,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date='2025-12-01') AS sales_receipts_1dec,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)='2025-12-01') AS sales_receipts_local,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_web_order_load WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)='2025-12-01') AS stg_local,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM o WHERE local_date='2025-12-01' AND web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line)) AS orders_wo_lines
FROM o

WITH o AS (
 SELECT web_order_id, status, login_state, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS local_date
 FROM fact_web_order)
SELECT o.status, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) orders, count(f.sales_line_id) lines, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM o LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.local_date='2025-12-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
